topic: Big Data and Distributed Data Processing
learningObjectives: Explain why distributed processing is used for large datasets.
Identify the roles of distributed storage and computation.
Construct a basic Spark-style data processing workflow.

activities.title: Big Data Map
activities.instruction: Connect common big data challenges with the distributed approaches used to address them.

content.concept: Big data systems use distributed storage and computation to handle datasets that may be too large or complex for a single machine.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Large datasets can exceed the practical storage or processing capacity of one machine.
Complex operations may require more computing resources than one machine can provide efficiently.
Stores data across multiple machines or storage nodes.
Splits computation so multiple machines can process data concurrently.
Allows distributed systems to continue operating when individual components fail.

activities.title: Distributed Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore the main components involved in distributed data processing.

content.concept: Distributed data processing divides storage and computation across multiple machines coordinated as a system.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Execute computation tasks on portions of the data.
Divide a dataset into smaller pieces that can be processed independently.
Coordinates available computing resources across the cluster.
Stores large datasets across multiple storage locations or nodes.

activities.title: Spark Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a basic Spark-style data processing workflow.

content.concept: Spark-style processing loads data, applies transformations, and executes actions to produce results.

activities.title: Partitioning Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust the number of partitions and observe how data is divided for parallel processing.

content.concept: Partitioning divides a dataset into smaller pieces so distributed workers can process portions of the data in parallel.
